jem_summary: Emit native redstone with a Secret Button and a chain-linked Lantern Button.

pages.title: Press Where?
pages.text: Emit native redstone with a Secret Button and a chain-linked Lantern Button.

pages.title: Press Where?
pages.text: Integrate controls into architecture; two button pairs support a working concealed entrance.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: A Secret Button matches the wall; a Lantern Button outputs at the chain top. Other types: alarm sounds, falling-material single-use, arrow-hit activation and Sticky Copper toggle.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Fit a Secret Button into a matching wall and press it. Activate a control disguised as a building material.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Activate a Lantern Button attached through a chain. Emit its redstone signal at the chain's top.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Press an Emergency Button. Trigger its alarm sound and button behavior.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Press a Sand, Gravel or Concrete Powder Button. Use a button that the author describes as pressable only once.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Shoot an Arrow Button, waterlog a Prismarine Button, or use Sticky Copper as a toggle. Different button types have distinct activation rules; Emerald has a variable pulse and Letter Buttons change character through sneak-click.
